description:
## Why This Exists

store/backfill.rs::backfill_overview() builds a HashSet<(String, i64)> of permanently-failed (group, article_number) pairs. On a server recovering from a large transit propagation backlog where IPFS is temporarily unavailable, every article in every batch gets inserted into the failed set. For a server with 10M articles, the failed set consumes O(n) memory with no cap.

The function was designed for startup backfill over a small number of missed articles. A large failed set also causes the progress==false early exit, but only after one full batch cycle per retry.

## Acceptance Criteria

Add a max_failures cap (e.g. 10000) to the failed set; log a warning and stop backfill when exceeded.
title: backfill_overview: failed HashSet grows unbounded on large backlogs
